description: [Transversal / Session Monitor] Retrieves the consolidated, real-time status of all living objects in a session (RFQs, settlements, escrow vaults, dispatch packets, bookings). Backed by Valkey L1 sub-millisecond cache with sovereign PostgreSQL audit fallback.

compact.description: If true, returns a condensed view. If false, includes full nested object schemas.

include_history.description: If true, includes closed/archived objects. Default returns only active or recently completed objects.

session_id.description: Stable multi-tool session identifier (e.g. b2a_sprint_d_20261015, bench_r3_ac49a710, trip_75297a)

name: geo360_session_status
